feeds.title: The OT Toolbox Blog
feeds.description: The OT Toolbox is a site for Therapists, Teachers and Parents. A blog about Occupational Therapy ideas, crafts, handwriting and cursive writing activities, visual perceptual skills, sensory processing. Occupational Therapist sharing creative OT tips and tools for helping therapists, teachers, and parents support their kids and students.

feeds.title: Your Therapy Source Blog
feeds.description: Your Therapy Source is your online resource for special education, pediatric occupational and physical therapy publications. Mission is To provide pediatric therapists, parents and teachers with educational resources.

feeds.title: Therapy Fun Zone Blog
feeds.description: I am an Occupational Therapist, and have a blog that features therapy activities. Therapy should be fun for the therapist and the client. Therapy fun zone is a place for therapists to share therapy activity ideas. We are a group of therapists who want to share information and give inspiration with activities for therapy.

feeds.title: Tools To Grow Blog
feeds.description: Resources & Activities for Pediatric Occupational Therapists, Educators, Special Needs Teachers, Therapists, Parents/Caregivers ... to help children Grow! The mission of Tools to Grow, Inc. is to provide valuable tools to therapists, educators, special needs teachers, and parents/caregivers to help with the most important job there is helping children grow!

feeds.title: Growing Hands On Kids By Heather Greutman Blog
feeds.description: Growing Hands-On Kids is a blog where they encourage independence, one activity at a time. Heather is a Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant turned homeschool mom blogger. She enjoys sharing hands-on activities for kids, homeschooling tips for particularly babies, toddlers, and preschoolers.

feeds.title: PocketOT Blog
feeds.description: Cara Koscinski, MOT, OTR/L is a pediatric Occupational Therapist and mom. She writes books and info. that contain questions frequently asked to pediatric occupational therapists about: -sensory processing -handwriting -core/body muscle weakness -feeding therapy -behavior -life-skills -coordination -transitions -school -IEPs -developmental information and MUCH more!

feeds.title: Your Kids OT Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Cindy and I am an Occupational Therapist. I enjoy working creatively with children to see them reach their potential. Your Kids OT provides paediatric occupational therapy services in Sydney, Australia. An information website and blog for parents, teachers and therapists with creative ways to make learning fun.

feeds.title: The Inspired Treehouse Blog
feeds.description: The Inspired Treehouse features child development information from pediatric therapists as well as gross motor, fine motor, and sensory activities designed to promote development through play.

feeds.title: Occupational Therapy Helping Children Blog
feeds.description: Occupational Therapy Helping Children is a private practice that operates on Sydney's North Shore and Northern Beaches. It was one of the first Paediatric Private practices set up in Sydney and has been operating continuously since 1994.

feeds.title: Emerge Pediatric Therapy Blog
feeds.description: The occupational & speech therapists at Emerge are dedicated to helping create confident children by providing a comfortable & customized learning environment. Get tips on different therapeutic attributes and to stay up to date with any industry news.

feeds.title: The Playful Otter
feeds.description: Children learn through play. As an occupational therapist who works with children and youth, I use games and toys almost every day to help develop important cognitive, visual perceptual, motor, sensory, social, play and leisure skills. While many different types of activities can be used in therapy, this blog focuses on off-the-shelf games and toys that are accessible to most.

feeds.title: FAB Strategies John Pagano, Ph.D., OTR/L
feeds.description: Strategies to help children & adolescents with Complex Behavior Challenges

feeds.title: Pediatric Occupational Therapy Tips
feeds.description: I am a pediatric occupational therapist with 24 years experience providing quality OT to children, along with caregiver instruction and support. My mission is to educate and empower therapists, teachers, caregivers, and parents of children with special needs.

feeds.title: Outdoor Kids Occupational Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Children's occupational therapy services in outdoor nature areas in Berkeley & Oakland. Therapeutic groups designed to build your child's motor skills, sensory processing, social skills, executive functioning, and general well-being through nature play.

feeds.title: Cutting Edge Pediatric Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Kate and Joe Lundgren are the proud owners of Cutting Edge Pediatric Therapy (CEPT), a occupational therapy clinic which opened in Allen, Texas in June 2013. Although CEPT is a full-service clinic, it specializes in children with special needs, spectrum-related disorders and sensory integration dysfunction.

feeds.title: wiredOn Development Blog
feeds.description: A website for therapists to explore excellence in the rehabilitation of neuromotor development and childhood disability A place for PTs & OTs working in neuromotor development and childhood disability to get inspired, stay updated and be informed.

feeds.title: Care Options for Kids Blog » Occupational Therapy
feeds.description: The Occupational Therapy blog by Care Options for Kids shares insights and tips on sensory play, outdoor therapy, and child development. It helps parents and caregivers support children's therapy and growth.

feeds.title: Pediatric Potentials » Occupational Therapy
feeds.description: The Occupational Therapy section of Pediatric Potentials shares articles and resources on helping children with sensory processing challenges, school transitions, and developmental growth.

feeds.title: Tumble N' Dots Blog
feeds.description: We offer Occupational Therapy, Speech-Language Therapy, and Feeding Therapy. We work with children of varying diagnoses, including autism, down syndrome, cerebral palsy, and sensory processing challenges. Practical tips for neurodivergent kids in Irvine.

feeds.title: The OT Butterfly Blog
feeds.description: The OT Butterfly Blog is full of educational resources about development, insights on sensory processing, and simple activities for parents to do at home with their neurodivergent child.

feeds.title: Hope Kids Occupational Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Discover expert tips and stories on child development and OT from Hope Kids OT. Learn, grow, and support your child. Explore our blog today!

feeds.title: My Pediatric OT Services Blog
feeds.description: Explore My Pediatric OT Services blog on occupational therapy for children and learn about the latest research, therapies and success stories.

feeds.title: Theracare Pediatric Services Blog
feeds.description: The specialists at Theracare Pediatric Services have accumulated a huge catalog of article on various Pediatric Services including speech therapy, OT & many others. Check them out to become more informed and aware about Children's health issues and pediatric therapy.

feeds.title: Kidstart Therapy Blog
feeds.description: The KidStart Pediatric Therapy blog focuses on how occupational therapy supports children's development through sensory integration, play-based learning, and skill-building activities. Based in Burnaby, British Columbia, it shares practical tips for parents on improving fine motor skills, attention, and self-regulation while highlighting how pediatric OT helps children gain confidence and independence in daily routines.

feeds.title: Pediatric Occupational Therapy Services Blog
feeds.description: The Pediatric Occupational Therapy Services blog is run by a New Jersey-based clinic founded in 1991. It shares helpful articles on sensory processing, motor skills, self-care, and school readiness, offering practical guidance for parents based on real clinical experience.

feeds.title: NAPA Center » OT
feeds.description: Explore the NAPA Center occupational therapy blog on our website for expert tips, activity ideas, and resources. Learn all about pediatric OT.

feeds.title: More To Say » Occupational Therapy
feeds.description: The Occupational Therapy section on the More To Say blog focuses on pediatric occupational therapy, offering guidance for parents on child development and everyday skills. The posts explain what occupational therapy involves, how play-based therapy supports growth, and ways families can encourage progress at home.

feeds.title: Inspire Connections Therapy Blog
feeds.description: The Inspire Connections Therapy blog shares helpful articles on pediatric occupational, speech, and physical therapy. Based in Ohio, it focuses on improving children's daily skills, sensory regulation, and communication through a family-centered approach.

feeds.title: Playful Progressions Blog
feeds.description: Explore the Playful Progressions blog for expert articles on child development, occupational therapy activities, and parenting tips from pediatric OT Maria O'Farrell.

feeds.title: Develop Learn Grow Blog
feeds.description: The Develop Learn Grow blog, created by pediatric occupational therapist Amy Hathaway, shares articles that help children develop sensory, motor, and fine motor skills through play, movement, and practical strategies. It covers topics like the sensory pyramid of learning, prone position activities, crossing the midline, and screen time alternatives. The blog offers easy-to-follow, activity-based advice for parents and teachers to support child development in daily routines.

feeds.title: Chatterbox Pediatric Therapy » Occupational Therapy
feeds.description: The Chatterbox Pediatric Therapy blog shares helpful articles on child development, focusing on occupational therapy. It covers topics like improving daily living skills, enhancing motor development through play, recognizing when early intervention is needed, and supporting sensory and self-regulation skills in children.

feeds.title: Blog Children's Therapy Solutions Blog
feeds.description: The Children's Therapy Solutions blog also focuses on occupational therapy (OT) for children, highlighting how OT supports development in areas like sensory processing, fine motor skills, handwriting, and daily living activities. It shares expert advice from therapists, practical tips for parents and teachers, and real-life insights into helping children gain independence and confidence through therapeutic strategies used in schools and at home.

feeds.title: Starfish Therapies Blog
feeds.description: Our blogs are inspired by our passion for enhancing childhood development and pediatric physical therapy. We write for both parents and professionals and work to provide a mix of education, activity/treatment ideas, and our favorite toys. Starfish Therapies is a pediatric therapy company. We provide physical & occupational therapy services for kids from 0-22 years old to address orthopedic & neurologic development through various activities.

feeds.title: Speech & OT Blog
feeds.description: Speech & Occupational Therapy of North Texas offers the highest quality speech, language and occupational therapy to the pediatric population in North Texas. We provide our services with a loving, nurturing attitude toward the child and with compassionate, comprehensive support and input for the family.

feeds.title: The Virtual Pediatric OT
feeds.description: In 2020 Michele started TheVirtualPediatricOT.com to help transition Pediatric Occupational Therapists into online therapy during the coronavirus pandemic. The Virtual Pediatric OT provides Resources for Pediatric Occupational Therapists and Teletherapists.

feeds.title: San Diego Occupational Therapy Blog
feeds.description: San Diego Occupational Therapy specializes in Pediatric Occupational Therapy (OT). Our pediatric occupational therapists help children develop the skills to perform the tasks of their everyday lives using creative methods to motivate the children and to ensure their experience at San Diego Occupational Therapy is successful and enjoyable!

feeds.title: MAC&Toys
feeds.description: I am a mom to the amazing 5 1/2 year old Quinn Eloise and wife to the most supportive Rob Reinhardt. I have been a pediatric occupational therapist in New York City since 2001. I have spent the last 13 years as a pediatric occupational therapist in New York City and have loved every second.

feeds.title: Premier Pediatric Therapy Blog
feeds.description: PPTS was started in 2011 by Dr. Debbie Allen, a pediatric occupational therapist, who has the belief that families deserve exceptional service and high quality care when they entrust themselves to professionals to address their child's therapeutic needs.

feeds.title: Alberta OT Pediatric Interest Group
feeds.description: This blog represents both the Calgary and Edmonton Occupational Therapy Pediatric Interest Groups, which have been meeting for several years! The purpose of the group is to network and share information about professional development, job opportunities and other information relevant to pediatric OT practice.

feeds.title: OT Mom Says
feeds.description: A place for ideas and inspiration to make the most out of everyday, as told by a busy mom with an occupational therapy perspective.

feeds.title: Write Now Services
feeds.description: Tiffany Powers-Reid is a registered licensed occupational therapist. She obtained her bachelor of science in occupational therapy from Boston University in 1994. Our goal is to equip children with the necessary tools to write with confidence and ease. The end result is better academic performance.

feeds.title: Therapy Services of Greater New York Blog
feeds.description: We provide occupational (OT) and physical therapy (PT) services to children with special needs, aged 0-21, so that they can reach their fullest potential. We specialize in Sensory Integration.

feeds.title: NTS Therapy Blog
feeds.description: NTS serves neurological to sensory issues including autism with occupational therapy from children to adults.

feeds.title: Raindance Occupational Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Raindance Occupational Therapy provides in-home services to children and adults with intellectual, cognitive and developmental disabilities in Oregon. OTs (Occupational Therapists) help people with disabilities live more independent lives. Raindance Occupational Therapy focuses on doing this through Behavior Assessments and Plans, Sensory Processing Evaluations & Living Skills Assessments.

feeds.title: Moore Pediatric Therapy Services Blog
feeds.description: Moore Pediatric Therapy Services specializes in providing speech and language, feeding and swallowing therapy along with occupational therapy, physical therapy and early intervention special instruction for children ages birth to three, preschool age, and school age in Moore, Montgomery, Richmond and Stanly counties.

feeds.title: Apex Occupational Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Alicia has worked as an occupational therapist since 2000. I'm enthusiastic about O.T. and enjoy the challenge of creating, researching. and learning new ways to help children and families. I have worked around the country as an O.T. and it has given me great opportunities and experiences.

feeds.title: The Thrive Group Blog
feeds.description: Thrive Occupational Therapy is founded by Miriam Manela, OTR/L, author of The Parent-Child Dance, with the philosophy that each child is unique and treatment must reflect this. In helping build a whole child, a major emphasis is placed on that child's relationships, whether they are the child-therapist, parent-therapist, or parent-child relationship.

feeds.title: FUNdamentals and Building Blocks
feeds.description: FUNdamentals is a pediatric occupational therapy clinic. Melissa Grant, owner, has 11 years of experience working with children who have autism, attention deficit disorder, attention deficit hyperactive disorder, developmental delay, Down Syndrome, fine or visual motor delay, fetal alcohol syndrome.

feeds.title: ABC Pediatric Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Created in 1994, ABC Pediatric Therapy lives it's mission of 'creating the best life for all children' by providing the highest quality of speech, physical, and occupational therapy in a child friendly environment.

feeds.title: The Well Balanced OT Blog
feeds.description: A blog written by an Occupational Therapists about child development, best practices in sensory integration, feeding therapy, and more!

feeds.title: Year One Wellness Blog
feeds.description: The Year One Wellness blog shares educational content focused on early childhood development, including feeding, sleep, physical and occupational therapy, sensory processing, and key infant milestones. Written by professionals like Michael Brodzik and Kristi Hammerle, the posts guide parents on topics such as transitioning to solids or understanding sensory development.

feeds.title: Therapy Works Blog
feeds.description: The Therapy Works Clinic blog shares information on pediatric occupational, physical, and speech therapy. It includes helpful articles on using virtual therapy, building healthy habits, and supporting children's development through engaging activities.

feeds.title: The Organized Occupational Therapist Blog
feeds.description: The Organized OT blog, based in Pinellas County, Florida, shares practical tips and resources for occupational therapists to stay organized and efficient in their work. It covers topics like therapy planning, documentation strategies, time management, and tools that make pediatric therapy more structured and effective.

feeds.title: Joy and Laughter Developmental Therapy
feeds.description: Joy & Laughter Developmental Therapy is a small pediatric private practice which works which children and their families to achieve independence in childhood. We provide occupational therapy, speech therapy, feeding programs, handwriting programs, and social groups to children aged 0-15 years of age.

feeds.title: Miss Jaime O.T.
feeds.description: Hi! I am Miss Jaime and I've been a Long Island pediatric OT for seventeen years. I currently work in a public school in Nassau County with students Kindergarten to 5th grade.

feeds.title: Skills On The Hill Blog
feeds.description: At Skills on the Hill, we treat the whole child by considering the environment, the child's strengths and weaknesses, and what is meaningful to the child. We know that the child will do best when he or she is comfortable and motivated, so we disguise everything as play. At our pediatric occupational therapy clinic we address motor delays, visual motor and perceptual deficits.
